quality_highlights.aspect: PAT setup instructions are precise and actionable: step-by-step with CLI command, permission table, and pre-filled GitHub URL. Excellent model for setup documentation.
Error messages in permissions_validation.go are high-quality: quote the bad value, offer 'Did you mean' suggestion, list valid options, include docs URL. Professional pattern.

single_file_improvements.issue: Lines 75-77: Duplicate paragraph. 'By default, the GitHub Tools can read from the current repository and all public repositories...' appears twice in a row. First instance (line 75) has extra detail about tools.github.allowed-repos; second instance (line 77) is a shorter duplicate. Looks like a copy-paste error.

Best Practices section (line 131) is a single wall-of-text paragraph containing five separate practices. No list formatting, no visual breaks. Additionally, Related Documentation section has a duplicate 'Using MCPs' link (lines 143 and 146, same URL /gh-aw/guides/mcps/).
